summary: Full backend + frontend E2E testing of PilotWX auth (register/verify/login/forgot/reset/delete) plus airports, geocode, weather, favorites, prefs. All 25 pytest cases passed. Frontend register->verify(OTP from Mongo)->dashboard->settings->delete-account flow verified via Playwright on mobile viewport (390x844). Wrong-password rejection, deleted-account confirmation modal, and post-delete login failure all work. No critical issues found. Minor: FastAPI @app.on_event('startup') is deprecated (should use lifespan handlers). Minor RN warning: props.pointerEvents deprecated (from react-native-web internals, non-blocking).

minor.issue: FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') is deprecated; migrate to lifespan context manager. Non-blocking.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Coming from a react-native-web component (likely modal/overlay). Non-blocking but should migrate to style.pointerEvents.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Replace @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') with FastAPI lifespan handlers in /app/backend/server.py.
OPTIONAL: Search UI code for pointerEvents={...} and move to style={{ pointerEvents: ... }} to silence RN warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses proper /api prefix, MongoDB via env, excludes _id in responses, hashes passwords with bcrypt, JWT via env, and cleanly cascades delete across users/favorites/prefs/otps.
OTP verify_otp() correctly caps attempts at 5, expires after 15 min, and deletes on success or exhaustion.
Route ordering is safe: /api/auth/me (GET) does not clash with /api/auth/{path} POSTs.
Frontend testIDs are present on every interactive element required by the review request.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral test users created and cleaned up by the auth flow test itself (delete-account) and by the favorites test's test_99_cleanup step. No lingering test data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_auth_and_api.py. Use domain example.com in emails (pydantic EmailStr rejects some TLDs like .local). OTP codes must be pulled from Mongo `test_database.otps` collection ({email, purpose:'verify'|'reset'}). EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL is used for API base. Frontend uses Expo Router with /auth/* routes and /(tabs)/settings.
rca_of_issue: N/A - no bugs found. Original pytest failures were caused by using a `.local` TLD in test emails, which pydantic's EmailStr validator rejects with 422. Switched to example.com and all tests pass.
